reviews.text:
Pet Medical Center of San Antonio took phenomenal care of my dog Ace on a last-minute reservation, with the staff showing unmatched professionalism and warmth from start to finish. They constantly gave me total peace of mind by reaching out with photo updates, easily making this the best veterinary team I have ever dealt with!
You've made a permanent client out of me!
The best vet service in town.

For several years we have taken our own three dogs, as well as several foster dogs, to Dr. Weeks.  We have had several procedures done, including teeth cleaning, neuter/spay, etc.  We have also boarded two of our dogs.  We have always been treated professionally and timely by Dr. Weeks and his staff.  We recommend Pet Medical Center.

We Love Pet Medical Center and all the services offered. Dr. Weeks is Awesome!
☆☆☆☆☆

Just off the phone with this place, more interested in a $70 deposit up front to make an appt than anything else. Then I read the reviews…hard pass on these guys. The cruel  and uncaring review did it for me. Taking our boy Dillon anywhere else but here. Zero Stars here…had to give 1 star as this was the lowest possible option.

Thank you for your response. Your young receptionist definitely needs additional training on how to handle new patients. Pls let her know that her demeanor and uncaring attitude lost a new client today. We just wanted to bring our 13 yr old guy in to discuss his medical issues and probable end of life planning. Read some great reviews and some not so great reviews but truthfully, we’d rather err on the side of caution with a one and done visit. All our best….JC and Marisol Jimenez
Our furry daughter loves this place! She was always excited to go in. Dr Weeks was the best, my dog loves him too. He spent time with her and us so we always feelt safe.
They always take care of my cat they are a bit pricey but so far they do everything I ask
Great Doc, great team.
Dr. Weeks has taken very good care of our fur baby!

Great service will definitely come back
Only thing guy employee ate all the guest cookies

I don’t believe Dr. Weeks is aware of how poorly some of his staff speak about him. While I was waiting, I overheard one of the receptionists on the phone with a client saying that Dr. Weeks “doesn’t know what he’s doing” and even blaming him for giving a pet pneumonia. After hanging up, she continued speaking negatively about him to another receptionist. I had come in hoping to establish care for my pet, but after witnessing that, I will not be returning. The receptionist’s name, I believe, was Savannah. I truly feel bad for Dr. Weeks he deserves a staff that shows him respect rather than undermines him.

Vet was was dismissive and uncaring, vet assistant was downright cruel!

Vet assistant told us medicines are all the same so if we tried one then give up and put our healthy 7 year old pet to sleep. Unbelievably bad experience with them, worse than the lies they told us and unhelpful advice that we were so clear we had already tried, they then had us waiting for MONTHS to hear from their behavioral specialist. Then they just ghosted us! Paying customers with no indication that they couldn't help, they just kept telling us that the vet is still talking with the behavior specialist and just wait to hear back.
They strung us along when we could have been going somewhere else for help (thank God we did eventually get real help) and even if they had some unspoken issues with us they could have just refused service, then we could have gotten help sooner.

Just to add clarity, we have a 7-yr old cat who has never (not even at the vet) hurt anyone. His behavior problem was peeing outside the litter box. They told us he's "mean" (that is a quote!!) and he should be 1. Locked in the smallest windowless room in my house until he does or 2. Put to sleep immediately

Yep! We asked for medicine but they said NO.

Just unreal poor medical service, I cannot comprehend the bad day someone is having that they tell a concerned pet owner this stuff!
Great service, no wait, caring staff.
Amazing staff and Doctor.
Great experience! The front office was very accommodating to my schedule, and Dr. Weeks  has great chair side manner and knowledgeable. I will be back !
Dr Weeks and staff are wonderful,  caring & professionals thru & thru
480 plus 90 for dog teeth cleaning they are a joke here
Weeks has the best Pet Medical Center and he's the best veterinarian I think San Antonio has
Great service, and the pricing was accurate. No surprises
Dr. Weeks is great Vet. His office is very well ran.👍 …
The staff is so friendly and helpful, and they all really make you and your furry friends feel like family. I highly recommend them for all of your pet medical needs!
Large facility with boarding service.  The rate for the standard boarding service is excellent
Great staff.  The VET is outstanding and caring.
